title: Segmented control
description: A row of radios wearing one pill. Switching views or modes, cast as a single control.
usage: For 2–4 mutually exclusive modes that switch content in place (Day / Week / Month). For settings that submit with a form, Tabs or Radio group may fit better.
a11y: Real radio inputs underneath, so arrow keys and screen readers behave. The pill is presentation only; the group is a named radiogroup and each segment is named by its label text. Each group needs its own name attribute: a sample pasted twice with the same names joins one radio group. Unchecked text measures 6.55:1 light / 5.81:1 dark on the segment track; the selected segment 17.72:1 / 16.12:1. Beta until a recorded screen-reader pass.
